quality_floor: 2,000+ tests and 85%+ branch coverage at v0.8.0

local_validation.scope: the maintainer's workstation, where the GPU and Windows-specific paths actually run
local_validation.commit_relationship: exact implementation commit plus following validation-record-only updates; the final pull-request head is validated by CI

cpu_non_gpu_non_network.skip_reason: six platform/privilege skips plus three pinned-verl conformance skips while the official package was intentionally absent from the general environment; the conformance tests were run separately against the pin

release_validation.scope: the exact published commit, validated by CI rather than locally
release_validation.gpu_coverage: none; no GPU runner is configured for this repository, so the GPU counts above exist only from the local measurement
